context:
Goal: a merge frees disk without losing a running agent's work.
Problem (risk): freeing a running agent's worktree loses its uncommitted files.
Based on (read): guard rule worktree-home (decision an-agent-outside-its-home-tree-must-stop) already stops an agent whose worktree is gone, so it cannot write into main.
Based on (ruling): decision when-a-worktree-may-be-removed (owner, 2026-10-25): the merge removes the merged branch's worktree once it has been idle long enough. Asked again because you reopened item 357 at 14:12 CST.
Departs from: main, where the merge frees any lock it finds. Each option adds a test before the free.

options.label: Never free a running agent's lock; the worktree goes when the agent ends
options.lose: The disk stays used until the agent ends. A finished agent's leftover files are not saved.

options.label: Save, then free: copy uncommitted changes to an archive ref, then remove the worktree
options.lose: The running agent is stopped mid-run and must be resumed.

options.gain: Nothing is lost from a running agent. A finished agent's leftover files, such as red-run files, are saved before its worktree goes. It also covers the coordinator's 14:11 CST cleanup pick on step notes-fix-large-1.
options.label: Both: a for running agents, b for finished ones (recommended)
options.lose: One extra git write for each freed worktree.

reply: Not a question after all (coordinator, 14:16 CST). Decision when-a-worktree-may-be-removed already says a: the merge removes a worktree only when it is clean, with no lock, session or process in it, and a worktree with unsaved changes is never removed. The gap was the code: merge.py freed an agent's own lock after 30 idle minutes. Lane worktree-unique-branch makes the code follow the record.
short: Merge and a running agent's worktree: keep, save-then-free, or both
title: How should a merge free disk without losing a running agent's work?
why: You reopened this in chat at 14:12 CST. You lean to a, and want the other options confirmed first. Lane worktree-unique-branch builds a meanwhile.
